name: Swiss Chard
siboNotes: Excellent choice for SIBO diet as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides essential nutrients without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Separate stems from leaves - stems take longer to cook
Sauté stems first, then add leaves in final 2-3 minutes
Remove tough ribs from large leaves before cooking
Can be eaten raw when young and tender in salads
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of vitamin K for bone health
High in vitamin A and beta-carotene
Good source of iron and vitamin C
